BiblicalUsage: Bakbukiah is a Levite who led thanksgiving in prayer when the wall was finished. He stood among the gatekeepers at the dedication, and he is named again among those who kept the watches in the days of Nehemiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the men who led the praise when the work was done matter as much as the men who built the wall, and Bakbukiah's name is kept because he gave thanks.
